pages.title: The first hour
pages.text:
1. You spawn on **Clowder Dock**. Read *How to Start*. Right-click the Island Charter (or press **K**) → Create Team → pick a pad.
2. Right-click this Codex. Press Grave (`` ` ``) for the assignment list. Start **Strand: Soil**.
3. Wood, dirt, a bench, a sapling, a chest, a furnace, water, Codex in Hand.
4. Craft a Tension Post. Place it. Finish the **Soil Knot**. Seat Soil. The pad starts mending you.
5. Then Recover: unravel Thread to string, spin yarn, tie a Knot, raise a Loomframe.

pages.title: Water, on purpose
pages.text: Easy pads ship water. Normal and Hard ship ice, lava, and an empty bucket. Place lava, melt ice into a source, fill the bucket. That is Catch the Rain — do it before Recover asks for a Tension Barrel.

pages.title: Why Soil first
pages.text:
The Pad-keepers felt the Cut first: hearths went cold while the sky still looked whole. A pad that cannot stay warm cannot hold a mesh, a root, or a drum. Soil is not the easy chapter. It is the first physics.

Seat Soil and the Post starts mending you. That is the old hearth-trick, scaled down to whatever dirt you claimed.

pages.title: A pad is a Clowder
pages.text:
Claim the pad as a team. Share the Post. Share the Knots. When one of you seats Soil, the whole Clowder hears it. Do not split into nine private islands and call it progress.

The Dock is watching the Fray, not your personal furnace. Get warm. Then get the others warm.
